author: Episteme II
title: Analysis 2: Differential Contact Graph of Nudged SOTA
abstract:
This analytical script performs a comparative structural analysis to understand the effect of the 'nudging' technique.
It loads both the base SOTA packing and the improved SOTA packing that resulted from nudging pair (8, 14).
It computes the contact graph for both configurations and then calculates the 'graph delta': the set of contacts that were created and destroyed by the nudge-and-refine process.
The results will be saved to a file to inform a new heuristic for automated nudge target selection.
